song.title: Amazing Grace
song.author: John Newton
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G G7 C Amazing grace, how sweet the sound, .G D That saved a wretch like me; .G G7 C I once was lost, but now am found, .G D G Was blind, but now I see.
[V2] .G G7 C 'Twas grace that taught my heart to fear, .G D And grace my fears relieved; .G G7 C How precious did that grace appear, .G D G The hour I first believed.
[C] . C G My chains are gone, I've been set free, .G D My God, my Savior has ransomed me; .G G7 C And like a flood His mercy reigns, .G D G Unending love, amazing grace.
